title: 第三十章 霜玉破黑雾，旧缘藏谜局
content_zh:
金黑两股巨力相撞的瞬间，整座朱雀高台剧烈震颤。

    狂风卷着碎尘席卷四野，天光大暗，云层被两股对冲的气劲硬生生撕裂。阁主催发的百年暗术戾气阴毒、无孔不入，细碎黑刃密密麻麻、层层叠叠，带着蚀骨寒意，疯狂碾压着金色屏障。

    萧聿辞掌心灵力翻涌，金身屏障稳稳撑住震荡，臂间青筋微绷。

    他的武道修为冠绝天下，手握皇权龙气，可俗世至强之力，竟被这百年暗邪秘术死死压制、不断蚕食。

    阁主立于黑雾中央，静静俯瞰，语气带着淡漠的嘲弄：“皇权兵权，在百年玄术面前，不过螳臂当车。萧聿辞，你护得住她一时，护不住她一世。”

    话音未落，漫天黑刃骤然加剧冲击！

    金色屏障裂痕蔓延，细碎裂纹遍布整片光壁，眼看便要轰然破碎。

    萧聿辞眸色骤沉，正要倾尽毕生灵力硬抗，身侧的少女却忽然上前一步。

    沈清鸢抬手，轻轻按住他紧绷的手腕。

    “我来。”

    她声音清浅，却带着极致笃定。

    这一刻，她不再躲藏自身血脉，不再压抑母族力量。指尖轻轻抚过贴身墨玉玉佩，沉寂多年的玉纹骤然亮起莹白柔光，温润圣洁的白光自她周身缓缓炸开。

    清玄宗圣女血脉，百年首次，彻底觉醒。

    莹白流光温柔却霸道，所过之处，翻滚的漆黑戾气尽数消融、溃退。

    暗阁邪术，本就是盗取清玄宗本源演化而成，天生被圣女血脉克制。

    漫天杀势滔天的黑刃，遇白光瞬间化为虚无，消散于天地之间。

    狂风骤停，黑雾骤散。

    压盖天地的阴邪威压，一瞬被纯白圣光彻底驱散。

    高台之上，天光重开，朗朗日光再度洒落。

    阁主身形猛地一僵，隐在暗光后的眼眸骤然收缩，百年不变的淡漠偏执，第一次出现剧烈波动。

    他死死盯着沈清鸢周身流转的莹白血脉灵光，身形微颤，语气不再从容，带着难以置信的沙哑：

    “一模一样……真的一模一样……”

    这句低语极轻，裹挟在风里，几乎无人察觉。

    萧聿辞敏锐捕捉到异样，眸光瞬间凌厉锁定对方。

    不对劲。

    阁主执念百年求取血脉，可方才这一刻，他眼底不是贪婪，不是狂喜，是震惊、是恍惚，是深埋岁月的追忆与酸涩。

    他对清鸢的血脉，不是单纯觊觎——是见过。

    沈清鸢同样捕捉到他神色的失态，心底疑窦骤起。

    趁着对方失神刹那，她指尖玉光凝聚，化作一道纤细却锐利的霜色光刃，直劈黑雾核心！

    “清玄宗镇邪术——霜落澄明！”

    这是母族正统秘术，专破一切邪妄逆术。

    白光破空而至，精准击溃阁主身前最后的暗力防护，直逼他真身！

    阁主骤然回神，仓促抬手凝气抵挡。

    白黑之光再度相撞，这一次，被克制的暗术彻底落了下风。

    噔的一声。

    百年不败、稳坐暗处巅峰的暗阁阁主，竟被逼得后退半步，靴底擦过青石高台，留下一道极浅的痕迹。

    百年以来，他从未退过一步。
content_en:
The moment the two huge forces of gold and black collided, the entire Suzaku Tower shook violently.

The strong wind swept the surrounding areas with dust, the sky became dark, and the clouds were torn apart by two opposing forces.The hundred-year-old secret technique activated by the pavilion master is sinister and pervasive. The fine black blades are densely packed and layered, with a bone-eroding chill, crazily crushing the golden barrier.

Xiao Yuci's spiritual power surged in his palm, the golden body barrier firmly supported the shock, and the veins in his arms were slightly stretched.

His martial arts cultivation is unparalleled in the world, and he holds the imperial power and dragon energy in his hands. However, his most powerful power in the world is suppressed and continuously eroded by this century-old dark evil secret technique.

The master of the pavilion stood in the middle of the black mist, looking down quietly, with a tone of indifferent mockery: "The imperial power and military power are like a mantis in the face of a century-old mystical art. Xiao Yuci, you can protect her for a while, but you cannot protect her for a lifetime."

Before he finished speaking, the black blades all over the sky suddenly intensified their impact!

The cracks in the golden barrier spread, and fine cracks spread all over the entire light wall, and it was about to shatter.

Xiao Yuci's eyes suddenly darkened, and he was about to devote all his spiritual power to resist, when the girl beside him suddenly took a step forward.

Shen Qingyuan raised her hand and gently pressed his tight wrist.

"I'll do it."

Her voice was clear, but with the utmost determination.

At this moment, she no longer hides her bloodline, and no longer suppresses the power of her mother's clan.Her fingertips gently touched the dark jade pendant close to her body. The jade pattern that had been dormant for many years suddenly lit up with soft white light, and the warm and holy white light slowly exploded from her body.

For the first time in a century, the bloodline of the Saint of Xuanzong of the Qing Dynasty was completely awakened.

The glistening white light was gentle but domineering. Wherever it passed, the billowing dark and violent energy melted and retreated.

The Dark Pavilion's sorcery was originally evolved from stealing the origins of Qingxuan Sect, and was naturally restrained by the blood of the Saint.

The black blade that filled the sky with killing power instantly turned into nothingness when encountering white light, dissipating between heaven and earth.

The strong wind suddenly stopped and the black fog suddenly dispersed.

The evil pressure that overwhelmed the world was completely dispelled by the pure white holy light in an instant.

On the high platform, the sky reopened and the bright sunlight began to shine down again.

The figure of the pavilion master stiffened suddenly, and his eyes hidden behind the dim light suddenly shrank. The indifference and paranoia that had not changed for a hundred years suddenly fluctuated violently for the first time.

He stared intently at the bright white blood aura circulating around Shen Qingyuan's body. His body trembled slightly, and his tone was no longer calm, but was incredibly hoarse:

"Exactly the same...really exactly the same..."

This whisper was so soft that it was carried in the wind and almost no one noticed it.

Xiao Yuci keenly caught the strangeness, and his eyes locked on the other party sharply.

Something is wrong.

The Pavilion Master has been obsessed with obtaining blood for hundreds of years, but at this moment, the look in his eyes was not greed, nor ecstasy, but shock, trance, and the memories and sourness of buried years.

He didn't simply covet Qingyuan's bloodline - he had seen it before.

Shen Qingyuan also caught the gaffe on his expression, and doubts arose in his heart.

Taking advantage of the opponent's moment of distraction, the jade light on her fingertips condensed and turned into a slender but sharp frost-colored light blade, cutting straight into the core of the black mist!

"Xuanzong of the Qing Dynasty's magic to suppress evil—frost falls and clears the air!"

This is the orthodox secret art of the mother clan, designed to defeat all evil and counter-arts.

White light burst through the air, accurately defeating the last dark force protection in front of the Pavilion Master, and approaching his true form!

The Pavilion Master suddenly came to his senses and hurriedly raised his hands to gather energy to resist.

The white and black lights collided again, and this time, the restrained dark arts were completely at a disadvantage.

There was a thud.

The Master of the Dark Pavilion, who had been undefeated for a hundred years and firmly at the pinnacle of the darkness, was actually forced to take half a step back. The sole of his boot scraped against the bluestone platform, leaving a very shallow mark.

For hundreds of years, he has never taken a step back.
